rules.statement: A sale of immovable property is voidable if the consideration afforded is so much an undervalue as to amount to laesio enormis, and a general permission from the Court under Section 8 of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance does not confer on a married woman the liberty to deal with her immovable property without specific conditions.
rules.supporting_quote: "There are no doubt persuasive arguments to support either construction. Certainly, the wording of section 8 is wide enough to admit of the latter approach. Nevertheless their Lordships are of opinion that the preponderating arguments tell against it."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 8 of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance (Cap. 57)
